positionAddress.description: Position the liquidity went into. Absent on fungible-LP AMMs, which hold liquidity as LP tokens rather than a position account.

positionRent.description: Native token locked as rent when this call opened the position. Absent when adding to a position that already existed, and on fungible-LP AMMs.

positionAddress.description: Address of the newly opened position. Absent on fungible-LP AMMs, which hold liquidity as LP tokens rather than a position account.

positionRent.description: Native token locked as rent for the position account, refunded on close. 0 on fungible-LP AMMs, which lock no rent.

positionRentRefunded.description: Native token rent returned when the position account closed. 0 on fungible-LP AMMs, which have no position account to close.

poolAddress.description: Pool the swap executed against. Set by the pool-scoped routes (/trading/clmm, /trading/amm), which resolve exactly one pool; a router picks its own path across pools and leaves this unset. Without it a settled fill cannot be reconciled to a venue without refetching the transaction.

parameters.description: AMM connector (only non-fungible-LP AMMs supported: meteora)

parameters.name: chainNetwork
parameters.description: Chain and network in format: chain-network (e.g., solana-mainnet-beta, ethereum-mainnet)

parameters.name: walletAddress
parameters.description: Wallet address to list positions for

get.description: Get a swap quote from a single AMM pool

parameters.name: chainNetwork
parameters.description: Chain and network in format: chain-network (e.g., solana-mainnet-beta, ethereum-mainnet)

parameters.name: connector
parameters.description: AMM connector to price the swap against

parameters.name: baseToken
parameters.description: Symbol or address of the base token

parameters.name: quoteToken
parameters.description: Symbol or address of the quote token

parameters.name: amount
parameters.description: Amount of base token to trade

parameters.name: side
parameters.description: BUY means buying base token with quote token, SELL means selling base token for quote token

parameters.name: poolAddress
parameters.description: Pool to trade against. Omit to resolve it from Gateway's configured pool list by token pair; pass an address to pin a pool that is not in that list.

parameters.name: slippagePct
parameters.description: Maximum acceptable slippage percentage. Defaults to the connector's configured slippagePct.

post.description: Execute a swap against a single AMM pool

Open a position with initial liquidity. On AMMs whose positions are discrete accounts (meteora DAMM v2) this mints the position and returns its address and rent; on fungible-LP AMMs (raydium, uniswap, pancakeswap) it performs the equivalent deposit and returns neither.
Add liquidity to an AMM pool from any supported connector
Remove liquidity from an AMM pool from any supported connector

Withdraw all of a position's liquidity. On AMMs whose positions are discrete accounts (meteora DAMM v2) this also closes the position account and refunds its rent; on fungible-LP AMMs (raydium, uniswap, pancakeswap) it withdraws the full LP balance and refunds no rent.
Create and seed a new AMM pool across supported connectors (Meteora DAMM v2, Raydium CPMM, Uniswap V2, PancakeSwap V2)
